# 8095 - Tri-state hex buffer

Package DIP-16 · family DM80 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/8095.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/8095.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 46 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![8095 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/8095.png) | ![8095 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-8095.png) | ![8095 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-8095.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 16 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |
| 8 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 1 | /G1 | enable | low |  | controls pins 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13; when not enabled: float; both G1' and G2' must be low to enable the outputs |
| 15 | /G2 | enable | low |  | controls pins 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13; when not enabled: float |
| 2 | A1 | input |  |  |  |
| 3 | Y1 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 1,15 |
| 4 | A2 | input |  |  |  |
| 5 | Y2 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 1,15 |
| 6 | A3 | input |  |  |  |
| 7 | Y3 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 1,15 |
| 10 | A4 | input |  |  |  |
| 9 | Y4 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 1,15 |
| 12 | A5 | input |  |  |  |
| 11 | Y5 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 1,15 |
| 14 | A6 | input |  |  |  |
| 13 | Y6 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 1,15 |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 3,5,7,9,11,13 | Y = A when /G1 = L AND /G2 = L; Z when /G1 = H OR /G2 = H | Non-inverting buffers; all six share the two control lines. Truth table: G1' H or G2' H -&gt; Hi-Z; both low -&gt; Y = A. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 32 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -5.2 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | DM80 figures from the electrical table: IOH -5.2 mA, IOL 32 mA. Off-state current -40/+40 uA. Over 100 like devices can share one bus line. Pin-equivalent to the DM54365. |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | Y | PLH | 10 | 16 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 50 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| A | Y | PHL | 14 | 22 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 50 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| G' | Y | PZH | 21 | 35 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 50 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| G' | Y | PZL | 24 | 37 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 50 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| G' | Y | PHZ | 6 | 11 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 5 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| G' | Y | PLZ | 16 | 27 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 5 pF, RL 400 ohm |

## Not known

- Recommended supply and temperature range for DM80 are not printed on the two pages read.
- No minimum delays printed.
